summary_en: 800,000 shares (1.42% of shares outstanding), ¥1.50B ceiling, open-market purchase Aug 10–Oct 30, 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled effective Mar 31, 2027. Purpose: capital efficiency and shareholder return in line with mid-term plan.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Shibusawa Logistics Corporation announced on August 7, 2026 that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition and cancellation of treasury stock under Articles 459 and 178 of the Companies Act.

The company will acquire up to 800,000 ordinary shares (1.42% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for a maximum of ¥1.50 billion through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 10 and October 30, 2026. The company notes that acquisitions may be partial or suspended depending on market conditions.

All acquired shares will be cancelled effective March 31, 2027. The purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns as part of the mid-term management plan (fiscal 2024–2026), while maintaining sound financial health and pursuing active growth investment.
